t: Crafting a Winning Investing Exit Strategy: Essential Tips for Savvy Investors
s: January 2, 2025 - We use the terms take-profit and stop-loss orders when talking about exit strategies to refer to the kind of exit being made. These terms are sometimes abbreviated as "T/P" and "S/L" by traders. Stop-losses or stops are orders you can place with your broker to close a position automatically at a certain point or price. The stop-loss will immediately be converted into a market order when this point is reached. These can help minimize losses if the market moves quickly against you. Stop-losses are always set above the current asking price on a buy or below the current bid price on a sell.
